resources.string: Camera access is required to scan cards.
⚠ Uneven light or a shadow by the card — light it evenly from above
⚠ Glare on the card — move the light or tilt the card slightly
⚠ Too dark — add light, or tap 💡 Light
⚠ Card isn\'t sharp — tap the card to refocus
Flashlight on: watch for glare on holo and shiny cards
Drag a line to fine-tune it. Solid = card edge, dashed = printed border. ≈ = grader standard not yet verified.
EX dot-code card: the bottom border is wide by design for the dot-code strip, so only left/right counts toward the grade for now. *Top/bottom is shown but not graded.
Official image of the identified card
Found it — check it matches your card, then confirm.
This card was reprinted with the same artwork and number — tap the set that matches yours (reprints carry their own set logo or stamp).
Best match by artwork — check it matches your card, then confirm.

resources.string: Couldn\'t identify this card — search by name, or skip.
Couldn\'t look up the card (offline?) — try searching, or skip.
Couldn\'t read this photo — search by name, or skip.
No official image\navailable for this card
Search: name and number, e.g. Ninjask 38

e-Reader cards have wider left and bottom borders for the dot-code strip, so top is compared with right, and left with bottom (collector convention). Put the dashed lines where the border meets the card frame, past the strip.
Auto: best contrast for this card
Couldn\'t find the card\'s edges automatically — drag the lines into place.
⚠ The card came out skewed, so these numbers aren\'t reliable. Retake — a plain background and the whole card in the guide box help.
The card is small in this photo, so centering is less precise. Retake closer so the card fills the guide box.
Couldn\'t analyze this photo for centering.

Magenta = whitening (bare card stock), cyan = dents and chips. *Corner rounding (mm) is shown but not graded yet. ≈ = estimate, not yet calibrated against graded cards. Glare can look like whitening — retake if a highlight follows a reflection.
⚠ Possible ding (seen in one photo only, not graded): %1$s — check it by eye.
Couldn\'t find the card in the turned photo — try again.
✓ Checked against a turned photo: only wear seen in both counts.
Shine at the edges (holo, foil, glare) can look like whitening. Turn the card 180° and check again: wear stays put, shine moves.
Corners & edges not assessed — the card\'s outline wasn\'t found
Couldn\'t analyze the corners and edges.
Card with whitening and corner wear highlighted
SURFACE SCAN · %1$s · Lay the card flat, tap it to focus, then Start. You\'ll tilt the phone slowly all the way side to side, then top to bottom, keeping the card in view.
Pass 1 of 2 · tilt slowly all the way left and right\n◀ left %1$s · right %2$s ▶ · %3$d frames
Pass 2 of 2 · tilt slowly, top edge all the way up and down\n▲ top up %1$s · top down %2$s ▼ · %3$d frames
Only %1$d sharp frames — try again, rocking more slowly.
%1$d frames combined, %2$d left out (blurred, or didn\'t line up). Not graded yet.
Each spot at its darkest across the scan, so reflections are gone.
How much each spot changed as the light moved: foil and holo light up, and so do scratches and dents.
The most level frame, for comparison.
The card\'s surface from the tilt scan
Nothing could be graded yet — retake the photos.
The %1$s\'s centering wasn\'t counted: the card\'s edges weren\'t found (or came out skewed) and the lines were left as detected. Retake, or drag the lines into place.
Possible ding on the %1$s (%2$s corner), seen in only one of the two photos and not graded — check it by eye.
Corners and edges weren\'t assessed on the %1$s (the card\'s outline wasn\'t found).
Surface isn\'t graded yet, so these are upper bounds: surface wear can only bring the grade down.
The overall grade is capped by the weakest category on either side; the category after each grade is what holds it there. ≈ = estimate, not yet calibrated against graded cards.
